original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 16 physical-memory-array capability and linkage field against the platform memory topology and across reboot.
original_method: Capture all Type 16 records with handles, normalize legacy/extended capacity and error-handle sentinels, cross-check expected Type 17 slot records, reboot under approval/recovery, then repeat and diff each array.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the physical-array/slot topology, unit/sentinel rules and reboot/recovery approval.
required_inputs: Expected Type 16 arrays and Type 17 slot capacity
safety_requirements: Do not suppress errors or bypass host authentication
Do not equate device-count capacity with installed DIMMs
Do not change DIMMs or memory settings
agent_execution_scope: Capture all Type 16 plus required Type 17 inventory
engineer_actions: Supply array/slot topology and unit/sentinel policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 16` is correct, but `grep -iA1` cannot collect seven fields or multiple arrays and cannot cross-check Type 17; insecure SSH and hidden errors are unacceptable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete Type 16 and related Type 17 output before and after an approved reboot, map handles and compare canonical plus raw capacity/sentinel values to the memory recipe.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All seven named fields, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model each Type 16 array as a node linked to its expected Type 17 slot records, storing raw and canonical capacities plus error-handle state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology semantics and extended-capacity/sentinel handling rather than a section snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing arrays, wrong maximum capacity/ECC/location, invalid error links and device-count mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may enumerate arrays differently; stable matching must use handle plus location/use/topology and flag ambiguity.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define installed topology versus supported slot capacity and exact legacy/extended capacity rules; this read-only row does not authorize DIMM changes.
expected_evidence: No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Type 16 array metadata and reboot persistence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, unit/sentinel policy, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents a one-line array heading and installed-DIMM count from substituting for the complete supported-array topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 16 describes array capacity and supported device slots, not individual populated modules. Correctness requires Type 17 topology correlation plus legacy/extended capacity and error-handle semantics. The read is automatable, while reboot approval keeps classification REQUIRES.
